verdict.rationale: Customer.io has its own in-product agent (segment building, workspace analysis, scheduled tasks, Slack), so letting that agent use tools from external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only documents Customer.io's own official MCP server, CLI, and Claude plugin, all of which let outside AI clients drive Customer.io. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about, so it cannot be credited here. Nothing in the pack shows the Customer.io agent connecting to or consuming third-party MCP servers.
